headline: National HackFest 2026 Championship Victory
body:
Event: National HackFest 2026 Championship.

Date: September 5, 2026.

SIET engineering student team secured First Prize and bagged Gold Medal with cash award of INR 50,000 at the National HackFest. The team was led by Dr. K. Arunkumar. Organizers commended their automated smart irrigation solution.
source_text:
# National HackFest 2026 Championship Victory

Event: National HackFest 2026 Championship.
Date: September 5, 2026.
SIET engineering student team secured First Prize and bagged Gold Medal with cash award of INR 50,000 at the National HackFest. The team was led by Dr. K. Arunkumar. Organizers commended their automated smart irrigation solution.
